headline: Here’s why the iPhone Duo’s hinge could be cracking the screen
summary: New iPhone Duo foldable phones are reportedly cracking at the hinge. Users shared photos showing screen issues appearing above the central hinge. The problem emerged within hours of the device's launch.

headline: Researchers are getting tired of OpenAI gatekeeping its breakthroughs
summary: OpenAI announced impressive breakthroughs in mathematics, computer science, and physics. Researchers are growing frustrated with OpenAI's 'evolving approach' to sharing findings. The company is accused of withholding its latest discoveries from the wider community.

headline: Elon Musk says Ukraine’s military violated Starlink’s terms of service
summary: Elon Musk claims Ukraine violated Starlink's terms by using it for offensive drone strikes. He stated the 'loophole was closed last week,' leading to service slowdowns. Ukrainian officials have denied these allegations.

headline: Trump is making it easier for fossil fuel companies to leak methane
summary: The Trump administration plans to weaken rules against methane leaks. Methane is a potent greenhouse gas, 80 times more powerful than carbon dioxide. This move is seen as a significant rollback benefiting oil and gas companies.

headline: The Upcoming Blade Runner 2099 Board Game Will Feature a Different Story Than the TV Series
summary: A new Blade Runner 2099 board game is in development. The game will feature a distinct story from the upcoming TV series. Fans can expect a unique narrative experience in the Blade Runner universe.

headline: Marvel's VisionQuest Episodes 5 & 6 Recap and Review
summary: VisionQuest reaches new narrative heights in its latest episodes. Episodes 5 and 6 highlight the fascinating dynamic between Ultron and Jocasta. The recap praises the evolving character interactions in the series.

headline: The 2026 55" LG Evo C6 4K OLED TV Drops to Black Friday Pricing Plus Get a Free Xbox Controller
summary: The 2026 55" LG Evo C6 4K OLED TV is now available at Black Friday prices. This deal includes a free Xbox controller, pairing a top-tier gaming TV with an excellent controller. It's presented as a premium offer for gamers.

headline: Masahiro Sakurai Shrugs Off AI Games as ‘Unprofitable Titles’ as Clones and Mods Boom
summary: Super Smash Bros creator Masahiro Sakurai dismisses the boom in AI-created games. He considers them 'unprofitable titles' and 'low-quality goods.' Sakurai believes AI games cannot compare to human-made masterpieces.

headline: Energy bill help, minimum wage rise and bank taxes - what could be in the Budget?
summary: Chancellor John Healey will unveil the UK Budget on October 28. Potential proposals include energy bill support and a minimum wage increase. New taxes on banks are also under consideration.

headline: Watch: What happens now after close vote in Israeli election?
summary: Polls have closed in the recent Israeli election. The vote resulted in no clear winner. Political analysts are now evaluating the potential implications and next steps.

headline: Defeated presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro arrives in US after Brazil cancels his passports, sources say
summary: Flávio Bolsonaro, a defeated presidential candidate, has reportedly arrived in the US. His arrival follows Brazil's decision to cancel his passports. Bolsonaro failed to surrender his travel documents to Brazilian authorities.

headline: King acknowledges 'suffering of the past' as Caribbean tour begins
summary: The King has commenced a nine-day tour of the Caribbean. He publicly acknowledged 'suffering of the past' during his visit. The tour includes stops in the Bahamas, Guyana, and Antigua and Barbuda.
